questions.title: What is Virtual DOM?
questions.notes: React compares virtual DOM with previous state before updating real DOM. Practice with a small examples.

questions.title: Explain useState with example
questions.notes: Used for local state management in function components. Good example is counter and toggle state.

questions.title: What is a promise in JavaScript?
questions.notes: Need to explain pending, fulfilled and rejected states with async/await examples.

questions.title: How do you optimize a React component?
questions.notes: Use memoization, avoid unnecessary re-renders, and split state logically.

questions.title: Difference between map and filter
questions.notes: Map transforms each item while filter returns subset matching a condition.

questions.title: What are React props?
questions.notes: Props pass read-only data from a parent component to its children.

questions.title: When should you use useEffect?
questions.notes: Explain synchronization with external systems, dependencies, and cleanup.

questions.title: What is event delegation?
questions.notes: Review event bubbling and handling events on a shared ancestor.

questions.title: Explain closures in JavaScript
questions.notes: A closure retains access to its lexical scope after the outer function returns.

questions.title: What is middleware in Express?
questions.notes: Describe the request-response lifecycle and the next callback.

questions.title: How does the Node.js event loop work?
questions.notes: Study event-loop phases, timers, I/O callbacks, and microtasks.

questions.title: What is a hash map?
questions.notes: Explain key-value storage, average lookup complexity, and collisions.

questions.title: Find the first non-repeating character
questions.notes: Use a frequency map, then scan the string in its original order.

questions.title: Explain time complexity with an example
questions.notes: Practice identifying complexity for loops, nested loops, and binary search.

questions.title: What is horizontal scaling?
questions.notes: Add more machines to distribute workload; compare with vertical scaling.

questions.title: How does a load balancer help?
questions.notes: Discuss traffic distribution, health checks, and availability.

questions.title: What is the difference between Flexbox and Grid?
questions.notes: Flexbox is primarily one-dimensional; Grid handles rows and columns together.

questions.title: How does CSS specificity work?
questions.notes: Compare selectors by ID, class, and element specificity, then source order.

questions.title: What is a controlled component in React?
questions.notes: The input value is driven by React state and updated through an event handler.

questions.title: How do you prevent cross-site scripting?
questions.notes: Cover output encoding, input handling, and avoiding unsafe HTML injection.
